samples.title: Điện thoại trong lớp
samples.prompt: In situations related to smartphones in the classroom, notifications can distract students. What are the causes of this problem, and what could be done to address it?
requirementsVi: Giải thích nguyên nhân.
Đưa giải pháp xử lý đúng nguyên nhân.

samples.summaryVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that teachers should allow phones for carefully planned classroom activities, a practical difficulty is that notifications can distract students. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

the proposal that

Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that phone rules are sometimes unclear or applied differently in each lesson. This can help explain why notifications can distract students. Consider the following situation: a pupil may stop following a discussion after receiving several messages from friends. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.

paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to agree on specific times for phone use and keep devices away during other tasks. For example, a teacher could allow phones for a five-minute research task and then ask students to put them in their bags. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.

samples.prompt: In situations related to social media use, strict limits may make some useful communication harder. What are the causes of this problem, and what could be done to address it?

samples.summaryVi: Giới hạn thời gian giúp bảo vệ việc học và nghỉ ngơi; nên tách tin nhắn cần thiết khỏi lướt vô thức.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that people should set clear limits on the time they spend on social media, a practical difficulty is that strict limits may make some useful communication harder. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

samples.summaryVi: AI hỗ trợ giải thích và luyện tập; cần kiểm tra thông tin và tự làm phần suy nghĩ chính.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that students should use AI as a study aid rather than as a replacement for their own work, a practical difficulty is that learners may accept incorrect information or avoid thinking for themselves. Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

Understanding why this happens is important before suggesting a solution. Otherwise, the same problem may return even after people have spent time and effort trying to improve the situation.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân

This can help explain why learners may accept incorrect information or avoid thinking for themselves. paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that local centres should provide beginner technology classes for older residents, a practical difficulty is that a fast lesson can leave beginners feeling discouraged. paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: Although there may be value in the proposal that people should check the source before sharing online news, a practical difficulty is that checking every detail can feel time-consuming.
